 TR.P(CRL.) NO. 68 OF 2025 : 3 :
 2025:KER:66473  ORDER
This petition is filed by accused persons 1 and 2 in S.C.No.1 of 2025 in Crime No.1189 of 2023 of Thalassery Police Station, now pending before the Fast Track Special Court, Mattannur.
The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 376, 354, 506 and 120B read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
According to the petitioners, they were practicing Lawyers appearing before various courts in Kannur and Kozhikode Districts.
The 1st petitioner was also a Public Prosecutor in Thalassery District Court from 2011 to 2016.
Therefore, they seek transfer of the above case from Fast Track Special Court, Mattannur to the Fast Track Special Court, Kalpetta.
2. Though notice was issued to the additional 2nd respondent/victim, she did not turn up.
Heard Sri.Sasthamangalam S.Ajithkumar, the learned senior counsel, as instructed by Sri.Serji Joseph Thomas for the petitioners, and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3. The learned Public Prosecutor has not opposed the application to transfer the case from Fast Track Special Court, Mattannur to the Fast Track Special Court, Kalpetta.

sentences.text: 4. At the time of arguments, it is revealed that, though the victim is a resident of Kozhikode, CWs 2 to 7, 11 to 16, 27 to 32 and 34 2025:KER:66473 are belonging to Thalassery, while CWs 22 to 24 are belonging to Ernakulam.

5. Sri.Sasthamangalam S.Ajithkumar, the learned senior counsel for the petitioners submitted that the distance from Thalassery to Kalpetta is 76 kms. and the distance from Kozhikode to Kalpetta is 72 kms., while the distance from Kozhikode to Manjeri is around 50 kms.

The learned senior counsel submits that since several witnesses from Thalassery also have to take part in the trial,
Manjery will be far away for them and that the Fast Track Special Court, Kalpetta will be the most convenient, considering the interest of all concerned.
6. Considering the fact that the petitioners are practicing Lawyers before the District Courts in Kozhikode and Thalassery and several witnesses in the Final Report are from Thalassery and Kozhikode, I also feel that the present transfer petition is liable to be allowed, as prayed for.
7.
In the result, this transfer petition is allowed and S.C.No.1/2025 pending before the Fast Track Special Court, Mattannur is transferred to the Fast Track Special Court, Kalpetta.

Sd/-
